nodes.description: IKernel public kernel stored in AppStorage; used for permission checks and app registry lookups.
bytes32 public appId identifying the app inside the kernel.
uint256 internal initializationBlock; 0 means the app has not been initialized yet.
Version[] versions array in Repo holding every published version.
Mapping from semantic version hash to version id.
Mapping from contract address to its latest version id.
address internal pinnedCode used by Proxy Pinned implementations.
Caller address supplied by the transaction; untrusted and used for authorization.
executorAddr.delegatecall(sig, calldataArgs) inside runScript executes arbitrary external code in this contract context.
versions.push(Version(...)) - 1 in newVersion mutates the versions array and indexes state.
_newVersion[i] - _oldVersion[i] uint16 subtraction in isValidBump; potential arithmetic wrap.
Inline assembly how := params forced cast plus mstore(how, byteLength) in canPerform modifies dynamic bytes memory.
require(canPerform(msg.sender, _role, ...)) authorization gate used by auth/authP modifiers.
IEVMScriptExecutor(executorAddr).execScript call resolved from registry data; untrusted executor code.
versions.length - 1 arithmetic used by getLatest and getVersionsCount.
modifier auth(bytes32 _role); requires canPerform(msg.sender, _role, new uint256[](0)).
modifier authP(bytes32 _role, uint256[] params); requires canPerform(msg.sender, _role, params).
AragonApp.canPerform(address _sender, bytes32 _role, uint256[] params) view; returns true when kernel is unset or kernel.hasPermission passes.
Repo.newVersion(uint16[3],address,bytes) auth(CREATE_VERSION_ROLE); publishes a new repo version.
Repo.getLatest() view; returns last version via getByVersionId(versions.length - 1).
Repo.getLatestForContractAddress(address) view; looks up latestVersionIdForContract.
Repo.getBySemanticVersion(uint16[3]) view; hashes the version and reads versionIdForSemantic.
Repo.getByVersionId(uint) view; requires id > 0 and returns the stored Version.
Repo.getVersionsCount() view; returns versions.length > 0 ? len - 1 : 0.
Repo.isValidBump(uint16[3],uint16[3]) pure; validates the semantic version bump rules.
internal pure helper hashing (version[0], version[1], version[2]) with keccak256.
EVMScriptRunner.runScript(bytes,bytes,address[]) protectState internal; resolves executor and delegatecalls it.
EVMScriptRunner.getExecutor(bytes) view; resolves executor address through the evmscript registry.
internal view reading kernel.getApp(EVMSCRIPT_REGISTRY_APP) to find the registry.
internal view using returndatasize/returndatacopy assembly to copy delegatecall return data.
modifier protectState; snapshots kernel and appId and requires them unchanged after execution.
internal onlyInit; sets initializationBlock = getBlockNumber() to mark initialization.
modifier onlyInit; require(initializationBlock == 0).
public view returning the initializationBlock state variable.
internal view returning block.number, abstracted for testing.
_newSemanticVersion uint16[3] parameter of Repo.newVersion.
_contractAddress address parameter of Repo.newVersion.
_contentURI bytes parameter of Repo.newVersion.
_versionId uint parameter of Repo.getByVersionId.
_oldVersion uint16[3] parameter of Repo.isValidBump.
_newVersion uint16[3] parameter of Repo.isValidBump.
version uint16[3] parameter of semanticVersionHash.
_sender address parameter of AragonApp.canPerform.
_role bytes32 parameter of AragonApp.canPerform.
params uint256[] parameter of AragonApp.canPerform.
_script bytes parameter of EVMScriptRunner.runScript.
_input bytes parameter of EVMScriptRunner.runScript.
_blacklist address[] parameter of EVMScriptRunner.runScript.
_script bytes parameter of EVMScriptRunner.getExecutor.
_contractAddress address parameter of Repo.getLatestForContractAddress.
_semanticVersion uint16[3] parameter of Repo.getBySemanticVersion.
_role bytes32 parameter of the auth modifier.
_role bytes32 parameter of the authP modifier.
params uint256[] parameter of the authP modifier.
local address contractAddress in newVersion, defaulted from storage when zero.
local uint versionId in newVersion derived from versions.push.
Version storage lastVersion reference in newVersion.
uint16[3] memory zeroVersion used for the first version bump check.
bool hasBumped tracking state in isValidBump loop.
uint i loop counter in isValidBump.
uint256 len caching versions.length in getVersionsCount.
bytes memory how assembled from params in canPerform.
uint256 byteLength = params.length * 32 in canPerform.
address executorAddr resolved by getExecutor in runScript.
bytes memory calldataArgs = _script.encode(_input, _blacklist) in runScript.
bytes4 sig = IEVMScriptExecutor(0).execScript.selector in runScript.
address preKernel snapshot in protectState modifier.
bytes32 preAppId snapshot in protectState modifier.
address registryAddr = kernel.getApp(EVMSCRIPT_REGISTRY_APP) in getExecutorRegistry.
bytes ret return buffer filled by returndatacopy in returnedDataDecoded.

edges.reason: auth modifier gates newVersion with an authorization check before the body executes.
protectState modifier wraps runScript and re-checks kernel/appId after the external delegatecall.
onlyInit restricts initialized() to a single call by requiring initializationBlock == 0.
auth modifier delegates the permission decision to canPerform.
authP modifier delegates the permission decision to canPerform with supplied params.
newVersion calls isValidBump to validate the semantic version bump.
newVersion calls semanticVersionHash when indexing versionIdForSemantic.
getLatest forwards the index to getByVersionId.
getLatestForContractAddress forwards latestVersionIdForContract to getByVersionId.
getBySemanticVersion hashes the supplied version before lookup.
getBySemanticVersion forwards the resolved id to getByVersionId.
runScript resolves the executor address via getExecutor.
runScript decodes the delegatecall return data via returnedDataDecoded.
getExecutor resolves the registry through getExecutorRegistry.
initialized reads the current block number from getBlockNumber.
msg.sender is passed as _sender into canPerform for the permission decision.
msg.sender flows through the auth modifier into the permission check.
_newSemanticVersion is written into the pushed Version struct.
_contractAddress determines contractAddress and the contract-indexed mapping.
_contentURI is stored into the pushed Version struct.
_versionId indexes the versions array after the require(_versionId > 0) check.
_oldVersion values feed the comparison and subtraction arithmetic in isValidBump.
_newVersion values feed the bump comparison and subtraction arithmetic in isValidBump.
version array elements are hashed into the semantic version hash.
_sender is compared against the kernel permission system.
_role selects which permission is required.
params are ABI-encoded into how and passed to hasPermission.
_script is used to resolve the executor and to build the delegatecall payload.
_input is encoded into calldataArgs sent to the delegatecalled executor.
_blacklist is encoded into calldataArgs sent to the delegatecalled executor.
_script is passed to the registry to select the script executor.
_contractAddress selects the latest version id mapping entry.
_semanticVersion is hashed and used for lookup.
_role selects the required role in the auth modifier.
_role selects the required role in the authP modifier.
params are forwarded into canPerform by the authP modifier.
kernel is used for the address(kernel) == 0 bypass and kernel.hasPermission call.
kernel.getApp is used to locate the evmscript registry.
appId is snapshotted and re-checked by protectState to detect state corruption.
kernel is snapshotted and re-checked by protectState around the delegatecall.
initializationBlock is the guard value checked by onlyInit.
getInitializationBlock exposes the initializationBlock state variable.
initialized writes initializationBlock to lock further initialization.
versions.length and versions.push drive the newVersion state mutation.
versions.length - 1 is computed to fetch the latest version.
versions array is indexed by _versionId in getByVersionId.
versions.length is cached and decremented in getVersionsCount.
versionIdForSemantic is written with the new version id in newVersion.
versionIdForSemantic is read by getBySemanticVersion.
latestVersionIdForContract is updated with the new version id.
latestVersionIdForContract is read by getLatestForContractAddress.
local contractAddress is derived from storage and stored back into the new Version.
local versionId is written into both index mappings.
hasBumped controls the later-element and short-circuit logic in isValidBump.
i indexes the semantic version arrays in the isValidBump loop.
local len is decremented before being returned.
how is the ABI-encoded permission payload passed to hasPermission.
byteLength = params.length * 32 is the length word written into how.
executorAddr is the target of the delegatecall in runScript.
calldataArgs is the payload forwarded to the delegatecalled executor.
sig is the selector used for the delegatecall.
preKernel is the state snapshot compared after execution.
preAppId is the state snapshot compared after execution.
registryAddr is derived from kernel.getApp and cast to IEVMScriptRegistry.
ret is the memory buffer filled by the returndatacopy assembly block.
runScript reaches the delegatecall unsafe operation after resolving the executor.
The delegatecalled executor executes in this contract's context and can re-enter runScript before protectState checks complete.
The external executor entry point can call back into the app, and only protectState guards the resulting state damage.
runScript performs the external execScript call on the untrusted executor.
_newVersion elements are subtracted and compared, feeding the uint16 subtraction site.
_oldVersion elements participate in the same subtraction and ordering check.
isValidBump executes the uint16 subtraction inside its loop.
versions array length is extended by the push operation in newVersion.
newVersion performs versions.push to append the new Version struct.
params is forcibly cast to bytes and its length word rewritten in assembly.
canPerform runs the assembly forced-cast block when params.length > 0.
msg.sender is the subject of the require(canPerform(...)) authorization gate.
The auth modifier performs the require(canPerform(...)) check.
versions.length is the operand of the length - 1 subtraction.
getLatest computes versions.length - 1 before calling getByVersionId.
getVersionsCount computes len - 1 after the zero check.
lastVersion storage reference is read for semantic version and contract address comparison.
zeroVersion is used as the baseline bump check for the first published version.

normalization_plan.reason: _newSemanticVersion is a newVersion parameter and only influences that function.
_contractAddress is a newVersion parameter resolved into contractAddress inside the function.
_contentURI is a newVersion parameter stored in the new Version struct.
_versionId is the getByVersionId parameter used to index the versions array.
_oldVersion is an isValidBump parameter used in the bump arithmetic.
_newVersion is an isValidBump parameter used in the bump arithmetic.
version is the semanticVersionHash parameter that is hashed.
_sender is the canPerform parameter checked against the kernel ACL.
_role is the canPerform parameter selecting the required permission.
params is the canPerform parameter encoded into the how payload.
_script is a runScript parameter controlling executor selection and calldata.
_input is a runScript parameter encoded into the delegatecall payload.
_blacklist is a runScript parameter encoded into the delegatecall payload.
_script is the getExecutor parameter passed to the registry.
_contractAddress is the getLatestForContractAddress lookup key.
_semanticVersion is the getBySemanticVersion parameter that is hashed.
_role is the auth modifier parameter forwarded to canPerform.
_role is the authP modifier parameter forwarded to canPerform.
params is the authP modifier parameter forwarded to canPerform.
local contractAddress is a newVersion-local resolution of the contract address.
local versionId is produced and written to storage only inside newVersion.
lastVersion is a newVersion-local storage reference to the previous Version.
zeroVersion is a newVersion-local baseline for the first version bump.
hasBumped is a local flag used only inside isValidBump.
i is the local loop counter of isValidBump.
len is the local cache of versions.length in getVersionsCount.
how is the canPerform-local bytes payload built by the assembly block.
byteLength is the canPerform-local params.length * 32 computation.
executorAddr is the runScript-local delegatecall target.
calldataArgs is the runScript-local delegatecall payload.
sig is the runScript-local selector used for the delegatecall.
preKernel is the protectState snapshot of kernel.
preAppId is the protectState snapshot of appId.
registryAddr is the getExecutorRegistry-local registry address.
ret is the returnedDataDecoded-local assembly return buffer.
